ai_tool_derived_inferences_metrics.completion_assessment: The logged automatic sequence and final disabled/CAN telemetry support a successful bounded positive test. The browser export itself still lacks a full five-second post-completion window, but the later controller-owned read-only sample independently provides a seven-second disabled/CAN-healthy observation with no serial command bytes or external CAN/motion commands sent. The constant browser dropped_logs=240 was already present before A/G and is consistent with strict CDC drop-on-no-listener semantics; it is not classified as a motion fault.
